title: Back in stock alerts
text: Back in Stock templates can use Product Name , Product URL , Variant Title and Product Price , plus customer and store fields such as Customer First Name and Shop Name . Product links include tracking parameters so you can see the visits in your analytics.

title: Back in stock alerts
text: An example using the Back In Stock - Standard starter template: Hi Sara , good news! The item Classic Linen Shirt from Your Store is finally back in stock. Grab it below before it sells out! Reply STOP to stop receiving messages.

title: Back in stock alerts
text: - Marketing messages. The library templates for Back in Stock are in the Marketing category. Meta charges more for these and may not deliver all of them. If you use the Blocklist, customers who opted out are skipped. - Subscription required. Every automated message needs an active WhatFlow plan. - Meta restrictions turn automations off. If Meta restricts your WhatsApp number, WhatFlow turns off Back in Stock and all other automations. Turn them back on yourself after Meta lifts the restriction. Restocks in the meantime are not notified.

title: Back in stock alerts
text: Customers get "Invalid phone number. Please include the country code." The number must start with the country code. Change Default Country Code Prefix in the block settings to your country so customers start with the right code. Nobody was notified after a restock - Back in Stock was off when the product was restocked. Those restocks are not sent later. - The template is not approved, or no template is chosen. - The customer is on your blocklist. The button doesn't show on the product page Check the badge under Product page button . If it says Hidden , click Show in theme editor . The block only shows on variants that are out of stock.

title: Abandoned checkout
text: Abandoned checkout sends WhatsApp reminders to customers who start checkout and leave without ordering. You can send up to 3 reminders, each with its own wait time and message. Home › Abandoned Checkout The page heading is Abandoned checkout .

title: Abandoned checkout
text: 1. A customer reaches checkout and enters their contact details, then leaves. 2. WhatFlow waits for the time you set for the first reminder (at least 30 minutes). 3. Before each reminder, WhatFlow checks that the checkout is still unpaid. Reminders stop as soon as the customer orders. 4. WhatFlow sends the reminder with a link back to the customer's checkout. 5. The next reminder waits the time you set after the previous reminder. When reminders stop WhatFlow does not send a reminder, and stops the sequence, when: - the customer placed an order from this checkout, - Shopify reports that the customer ordered since they left, - the checkout was completed, - any order was placed with the same phone number since the customer left, - the phone number on the checkout changed, - the checkout is older than 60 days. WhatFlow may also skip reminders for a customer who recently abandoned another checkout.

title: Abandoned checkout
text: The Template Library has three abandoned checkout templates: Abandoned Checkout - Friendly Reminder , Abandoned Checkout - Discount Offer and Abandoned Checkout - FOMO . They are Marketing templates. See Message templates. Under Reminders , set the wait time for Reminder 1 and choose its message. Click Add reminder to add a second or third reminder. Click Save . You see "Reminders saved." In the Status card, click Turn on . You need at least one reminder with an approved template, saved.

title: Abandoned checkout
text: For each reminder (up to 3): For Reminder 1 . How long to wait, in minutes , hours or days . At least 30 minutes. For Reminder 2 and Reminder 3 . The wait counts from the previous reminder, not from when the customer left. The template for this reminder. Each reminder can use a different template. A reminder with no template, or with no wait time, is skipped. Each reminder shows a badge, such as Not set up , Message missing , Ready or Sending . For example, Reminder 1 after 1 hour, Reminder 2 after 23 hours and Reminder 3 after 2 days sends at about 1 hour, 1 day and 3 days after the customer left.

title: Abandoned checkout
text: There is no discount setting on this page. WhatFlow does not create discount codes or apply discounts to the checkout. To offer a discount, put it in the template itself: - Write a fixed code in the message text, for example "Use code SAVE10 at checkout". Create the code in Shopify first. - Or add a Copy code button to the template with your code. The library template Abandoned Checkout - Discount Offer asks customers to reply YES to get a discount. WhatFlow does not send a code automatically when a customer replies YES. If you use this template, set up an auto-reply or a Shopify Flow workflow that sends the code, or have your team answer in Live Inbox. Otherwise, use a template with the code already in it.

title: Abandoned checkout
text: Besides the usual customer and store fields, abandoned checkout templates can use: - Recovery URL : the link back to the customer's checkout. - Checkout Total , Checkout Subtotal and Checkout Tax . For link buttons, choose Checkout Recovery URL . WhatFlow adds tracking parameters to the link so you can see which reminder brought the customer back. If the header is the product image, it uses the first item in the checkout.

title: Abandoned checkout
text: An example using the Abandoned Checkout - Friendly Reminder starter template: Hi Sara ! We noticed you left some great items in your cart at Your Store 🛒. Items: Classic Linen Shirt x 1 Total: 49.99 USD They're waiting for you! Tap below to complete your purchase now. Reply STOP to stop receiving messages.

title: Abandoned checkout
text: - Phone number needed. WhatFlow uses the phone from the billing address, shipping address, checkout or customer. If there is none, nothing is sent. - No order tags. A checkout is not an order, so no tags are added. - Marketing messages. These templates are Marketing. Meta charges more for them, they must offer a way to opt out, and Meta may not deliver all of them. If you use the Blocklist, customers who opted out are skipped. - Subscription required. Every automated message needs an active WhatFlow plan. Without one, reminders are skipped. - Meta restrictions turn automations off. If Meta restricts your WhatsApp number, WhatFlow turns off Abandoned checkout and all other automations. Turn them back on yourself after Meta lifts the restriction.

title: Abandoned checkout
text: Problem Why A customer got no reminder They ordered, the checkout was completed, the phone changed, another order was placed with the same phone, the checkout had no phone, or they recently abandoned another checkout. "The first reminder must wait at least 30 minutes." Set Reminder 1 to 30 minutes or more. "Cannot enable: configure at least one follow-up with an approved template and save settings first." Add a reminder with an approved template and click Save . "Your reminder messages are waiting for Meta's review." Wait for Meta to approve the template, then turn it on. Product image header fails The first item has no image. Add an image in Shopify or use a fixed header image.

title: Draft order recovery
text: Draft order recovery sends WhatsApp reminders after you create a draft order, until the customer pays. Use it when you make orders for customers by hand, for example from a chat, and send them an invoice to pay. Home › Draft Order Recovery The page heading is Draft order recovery .

title: Draft order recovery
text: 1. You create a draft order in Shopify. 2. WhatFlow waits for the time you set for the first reminder. 3. Before each reminder, WhatFlow checks that the draft order is still open. Reminders stop as soon as the customer pays (the draft is completed). 4. WhatFlow sends the reminder with a link to the draft order invoice. 5. The next reminder waits the time you set after the previous reminder. WhatFlow reads the draft order again before each reminder. If you add the customer's phone number after creating the draft, the reminders still go to it.

title: Draft order recovery
text: The Template Library has Draft Order - Custom Invoice Ready and Draft Order - Gentle Reminder . Both are Utility templates. See Message templates. Under Reminders , set Wait after the draft order is created for Reminder 1 and choose its message. Click Add reminder to add up to 3. Click Save , then click Turn on in the Status card. You need at least one reminder with an approved template, saved.

title: Draft order recovery
text: For each reminder (up to 3): For Reminder 1 . How long to wait, in minutes , hours or days . It must be more than 0. For Reminder 2 and Reminder 3 . The wait counts from the previous reminder. The template for this reminder. Each reminder can use a different template. A reminder with no template, or with no wait time, is skipped. There is no discount setting. To offer a discount, add it to the draft order in Shopify or write it in the template.

title: Draft order recovery
text: Besides the usual customer and store fields, draft order templates can use: - Invoice URL : the link to pay the draft order. - Draft Order Name , Draft Order Total , Draft Order Subtotal and Draft Order Tax . For link buttons, choose Draft Order Invoice URL . WhatFlow adds tracking parameters to the link so you can see which reminder brought the customer back.

title: Draft order recovery
text: - Phone number. WhatFlow uses the draft order's phone, then the billing address, shipping address and customer's default phone. - Failure tags. If a reminder fails, WhatFlow can add a failure tag such as WhatsApp: Not a User and a note to the draft order. See Failure tags. - Subscription required. Every automated message needs an active WhatFlow plan. Without one, reminders are skipped. - Meta restrictions turn automations off. If Meta restricts your WhatsApp number, WhatFlow turns off Draft order recovery and all other automations. Turn them back on yourself after Meta lifts the restriction. - Sending by hand. To send a draft order reminder once, without this automation, see Manual messaging.

title: Draft order recovery
text: Problem Fix "Cannot enable: configure at least one follow-up with an approved template and save settings first." Add a reminder with an approved template, click Save , then turn it on. "Set how long to wait before this reminder." Enter a wait time above 0. No reminders were sent The draft has no phone number, the template is not approved, or the automation was off when the draft was created.

title: Live Inbox
text: Live Inbox is the shared WhatsApp inbox in WhatFlow. Your team reads and answers customer messages there, on your connected business number, from a browser on a computer or a phone. Live Inbox runs on the same WhatsApp connection as the rest of WhatFlow. There is no limit on team members and no per-seat fee. Messages you send from the inbox count toward your plan like any other WhatFlow message. See Plans and billing.

title: Live Inbox
text: - Every customer who messages your connected WhatsApp number gets a chat in Live Inbox. One WhatsApp number is used per store. - Everyone on your team signs in to the same inbox and sees the same chats. Each person has their own login. See Team members and roles. - You can reply with free-form messages only while the customer's 24-hour window is open. After that, you can send approved templates only. - Live Inbox keeps message history for 30 days . Messages, reactions and media older than 30 days are deleted every night and cannot be recovered.

title: Live Inbox
text: The on/off switch for Live Inbox is in the WhatFlow app in Shopify admin, not inside the inbox. Shopify admin › WhatFlow › Live Inbox If your number is not connected yet, the page shows Connect WhatsApp to Activate Live Inbox . Click Go to Connections and follow Connect WhatsApp. On the WhatsApp Live Inbox page, click Turn On Inbox . You see "WhatsApp Live Inbox enabled successfully!" and the badge changes to Inbox ON . Click Open Live Inbox . The inbox opens in a new browser tab. When you turn the inbox on, WhatFlow checks your WhatsApp details with Meta. If your number also uses the WhatsApp Business phone app and was connected in the last 24 hours, WhatFlow also imports recent chat history from the phone app. When Live Inbox is off Click Turn Off Inbox to switch it off. While it is off: - New customer messages are not stored in the inbox. - You cannot reply to customers from the inbox. Private notes still work. - A banner at the top of the inbox says chat is turned off. - Your automations (order confirmations, shipping updates and the rest) keep working as normal. - You can still open the inbox and use broadcasts, workflows, templates, the blocklist and settings.

title: Live Inbox
text: The WhatsApp Live Inbox page in Shopify admin has two ways to open it. Button What it does Open Live Inbox Opens the inbox in a new tab, signed in as the store owner. Copy Direct Link Copies a sign-in link you can open in another browser or on your phone. You see "One-time inbox link copied. It expires in one hour." The direct link works once and expires one hour after you copy it. Opening it shows a page called Open WhatFlow Inbox . Click Continue to Inbox to sign in. Anyone who opens a direct link is signed in as the store owner , with full access. Do not share it with your team or paste it in a group chat. Give each team member their own login instead. See Team members and roles. After you sign in, you stay signed in on that browser for 7 days. Team members don't use these buttons. They sign in on the inbox login page with their own username and password.

title: Live Inbox
text: On a computer, the inbox has three parts: - Sidebar (left). Links to every page, grouped under Workspace and Manage . The Live Inbox link shows your unread count. Click Search or press Ctrl K (⌘ K on Mac) to find a customer, number, message or page. - Conversation list (middle). All chats, with filters at the top. - Chat (right). The open conversation and the reply box. On a phone, the list and the chat are separate screens. A bar at the bottom has Inbox , Templates , Search and More . More opens the full menu. You can install the inbox on your home screen. See Inbox settings and shortcuts. The browser tab title shows your unread count, for example "(3) WhatFlow Inbox". Some sidebar pages are only visible to the store owner. See Team members and roles.

title: Live Inbox
text: Each row shows: - The customer's name or number, and a preview of the last message. - The time of the last message ("Just now", "5m", "3h", "Nov 2"). - The unread count, labels and the assigned teammate. - Needs reply when the customer is waiting for you. - A countdown when the 24-hour window has less than 4 hours left, for example "2h 45m left". It turns amber under 4 hours and red under 1 hour. - Draft: and your text if you started a reply in this browser and did not send it. - A follow-up badge, red when it is due. - Ad · and the ad headline if the chat started from a click-to-WhatsApp ad. The list loads 100 chats at a time. Click Load more chats at the bottom to see more. Filters Filter Options Queue Everyone , Mine , Unassigned , each with a count. Only shown when your store has more than one active team member. Agents start on Mine , the owner on Everyone . Status See the table below. Label All labels , Unlabeled , or one label. Status Shows chats that All statuses Everything. Pinned chats come first. Unread Have unread messages. Needs reply Have an open window where the customer wrote last and the chat is not done. An automated message or broadcast sent after the customer's

title: Live Inbox
text: The chat header shows how long the customer's 24-hour window has left, for example "18h left" or "20m left". What you see Meaning Green countdown The window is open. Amber countdown Less than 4 hours left. Red countdown Less than 1 hour left. Templates only The window has closed. You can only send an approved template. The window lasts 24 hours from the customer's latest message. Sending a template does not open it again. It opens when the customer replies. While an inbox tab is open, you get an alert when a chat that is yours or unassigned has 30 minutes or less left and the customer wrote last. If the tab is in the background and you allowed notifications, you also get a browser notification "Window closing:" with the customer's name.

title: Live Inbox
section: Messages from the WhatsApp Business app
text: If your number also uses the WhatsApp Business phone app, messages you send from the phone appear in the chat too, including edits, deletions and reactions. In Inbox reports they count as Phone app replies.

title: Live Inbox
text: Live Inbox keeps messages for 30 days . Each night, messages, reactions and the media in them that are older than 30 days are deleted. Deleted messages cannot be recovered, and in-chat search, the media gallery and reports only cover what is still stored. Labels, canned responses and custom attribute values are not removed by this cleanup.

title: Live Inbox
text: WhatFlow has no built-in AI. You can connect an outside AI app, such as Claude or ChatGPT, from the AI connections page in the WhatFlow Shopify app. See AI apps (MCP). New AI connections start in draft mode. The AI's replies wait in Live Inbox until a person approves them. A draft appears above the reply box as "Draft from" and the app's name, with "not sent yet" and its expiry date. Button What it does Send Sends the draft to the customer as you. You need permission to reply to the chat. Edit Lets you change a text draft (up to 4,096 characters) before sending. Cancel edit keeps the original. Discard Deletes the draft. Nothing is sent. - A chat can have at most 3 drafts waiting. After that, the AI gets "This conversation already has 3 drafts waiting for review." - A text draft expires when the customer's 24-hour window closes. A template draft expires after 24 hours. - AI connections made by an agent are always in draft mode. Only the owner can turn draft mode off.

title: Live Inbox
text: Problem Fix "Please allow pop-ups to open the live inbox" or no new tab opens Allow pop-ups for Shopify admin in your browser, then click Open Live Inbox again. "Invalid or expired authentication token. Reopen the Inbox from your Shopify app." The link is older than one hour. Click Open Live Inbox again. "This launch link was already used. Reopen the Inbox from Shopify." Each link works once, so a refreshed page or a bookmark fails. Click Open Live Inbox again. "This inbox link is invalid or expired. Copy a fresh link from Shopify." Click Copy Direct Link again for a new link. "Connect WhatsApp before enabling Inbox." Connect your number first. See Connect WhatsApp. "No WhatsApp number linked" in the inbox Your WhatsApp number is not connected. Connect it in the WhatFlow app. Banner "Live Inbox chat is turned off in Shopify Admin" Go to Live Inbox in the WhatFlow app and click Turn On Inbox . "Inbox sign-in is temporarily unavailable." Wait a moment and open the inbox again from Shopify. If it keeps happening, email support@whatflow.tech. Old messages are missing Messages older than 30 days are deleted. They cannot be restored.

title: Replying to customers
text: The reply box at the bottom of each chat sends text, photos, files, voice notes, templates, buttons, products and checkout links. This page covers everything you can send from a chat, and the customer panel next to it.

title: Replying to customers
text: You can reply when all of these are true: - Live Inbox is turned on in the WhatFlow app. If it is off, the reply box says "WhatsApp Live Inbox is currently turned off." See Live Inbox. - You are the owner, or the chat is assigned to you. Agents see "This chat is unassigned." with a Claim and reply button, or "Claim this chat or ask the owner to assign it to you before replying." See Team members and roles. - For anything other than a template, the customer's 24-hour window is open. When the window is closed, the text box is hidden and you see "The 24-hour reply window is closed. Send an approved template to restart the conversation." with a Send template button. The bar above the reply box switches between Reply and Private note . Private notes are only seen by your team. See Assign, label and note.

title: Replying to customers
text: Type in the reply box and press Enter to send. Press Shift+Enter for a new line. - A message can be up to 4,096 characters . A counter appears from 3,500 characters. - Your unsent text is saved in this browser ("Draft saved on this device") and shows as Draft: in the conversation list. - Insert emoji opens a set of 30 popular emojis. - While you type and the window is open, the customer sees "typing…" in WhatsApp. You can turn this off in settings. Undo send Undo send is on by default. After you press Enter, the message waits 5 seconds and shows "Sending in 5s" with Undo and Send now . - Undo stops the message from being sent. - Send now sends it straight away. - If you switch chats or close the tab, the message is sent at once. Undo send only applies to text messages, not to media or templates. You can turn it off in settings. Reply to a specific message Hover over a message (or tap it on a phone) and choose Reply to message . The reply box shows "Replying to" and the quoted text. The customer sees your reply attached to their message in WhatsApp. Press Esc to cancel.

title: Replying to customers
text: Click the attachment button ("Attach media, document, contact or location"). Option What you can send Size limit Photos & videos JPEG, PNG or WebP images. MP4 or 3GPP videos. A WebP image is sent as a sticker. Images 5 MB. Videos 16 MB. Stickers 100 KB (500 KB animated). Document PDF, Word, Excel and plain text files 100 MB Audio file AAC, AMR, MP3, M4A or OGG 16 MB Contact card Full name , Phone number , Company , Email address Location pin Latitude , Longitude , Place name and Street address , or your current location Before you send a photo, video or file, you can add a Caption . To record a voice note, click Record voice note (the microphone). Your browser asks for microphone permission the first time. Media can only be sent while the window is open.

title: Replying to customers
text: Canned responses are saved replies your team can insert into a message. They are shared by everyone in your store. To use one, type / in the reply box, or click Canned Responses . Search by title, shortcut or text, use the arrow keys to choose, and press Enter. The text is put into the reply box so you can check it. It is never sent automatically. These variables are filled in when you insert a canned response: Variable Filled with {name} The customer's first name {full name} The customer's full name {phone} The customer's number {agent} Your name {store} Your store name Any other text in braces, such as {order} , stays in the message and is selected so you can type over it. Create canned responses Only the store owner can create, edit or delete canned responses. Agents can use them. Live Inbox › Canned Responses A name for the reply, up to 80 characters. Letters, numbers and underscores, up to 30 characters. Must be unique in your store. The reply text, up to 4,096 characters. Can include the variables above. Canned responses are not WhatsApp templates. They follow the same 24-hour window rules as any typed reply.

title: Replying to customers
text: Templates are the only messages you can send when the 24-hour window is closed. You can also send them while it is open. 1. Click Send approved template in the reply box, or Send template when the window is closed. 2. Pick a template. Only templates approved by Meta for your connected number are listed. 3. Fill in every variable. If the template has an image header, paste a public link starting with https://. In the Send approved template dialog you can also upload a JPEG or PNG up to 5 MB. If the template has a link button with a variable part, fill in the link. 4. For catalog or multi-product templates, choose the products. 5. Check the preview and send. Sending a template does not open the 24-hour window. It opens when the customer replies. See Message templates for how templates work. Create templates in the inbox The Templates page lists your templates live from Meta. Click Sync to fetch the latest status. You can filter by status (approved, pending, rejected) and by category. The store owner can click Create template to submit a new one to Meta. You set the Template name , Category , Language , Template type (Standard, Catalog or Multi-product), an optional text header, the b

title: Replying to customers
text: Open the menu with More ways to send (⋯) in the chat header and choose Send interactive message . This needs an open window. Type What the customer gets Limits Reply buttons A message with up to 3 buttons to tap Button text 20 characters CTA Link A message with one button that opens a web link Button label 20 characters List options A button that opens a list of choices, in sections Up to 10 rows in total. Row title 24 characters, description 72 Media carousel 2 to 10 cards that scroll sideways, each with an image or video Card text 120 characters. Each card has one link button or one or two quick reply buttons The message body can be up to 1,024 characters and the footer up to 60. Image and video headers need a public link; you cannot upload a file here. The CTA Link button opens a web link only. There is no call-phone button in interactive messages. Phone buttons are only available in templates. When a customer taps a reply button or picks a list item, their choice appears in the chat as a message.

title: Replying to customers
text: Choose Send products from More ways to send . This needs an open window and a product catalog synced to Meta. If you see "No catalog yet", your catalog has not been synced. Mode What the customer gets One product One product with a View button Product list Up to 30 products in up to 10 sections. The customer can add items to a WhatsApp cart. Needs a heading. Carousel 2 to 10 products that scroll sideways. Needs a message. Whole catalog A View catalog button, with an optional cover product. Needs a message.

title: Replying to customers
text: When a customer sends you a WhatsApp cart, it shows in the chat as an order card with the items and Total . When a customer asks about a product, it shows as an "Asked about" card where you can pick a variant and click Send product or Checkout link . Click Send checkout link to send the customer a button that takes them to checkout. Cart link opens checkout with these items. Prices come from your store. Draft order invoice creates a draft order in Shopify, which you can still edit, and sends its invoice link. Optional, for Cart link only. Up to 100 characters. The text above the button, up to 900 characters. The customer gets a Checkout button for a cart link, or a View invoice button for a draft order. You can set the quantity of each item from 1 to 999. Items that are not Shopify products are left out and you see a note. To reply to every cart automatically, see Workflows, Flows and webhooks.

title: Replying to customers
text: Hover over a message (or tap it on a phone) and choose React to message . Pick an emoji. Choose the same emoji again to remove it. - Reactions are sent from your business, not from each teammate. - You can react to messages from the last 30 days. - Reactions do not open the 24-hour window.

title: Replying to customers
text: Click the ticks under a message you sent to see its status. Status Meaning "Sending to WhatsApp…" Not sent yet. "Sent. Not delivered to the customer's phone yet." WhatsApp has it, but the phone has not received it. "Delivered to the customer's phone. Not read yet." The phone received it. "Read by the customer." The customer opened it. If a message fails, the inbox explains why in plain words. For a failed text message you can click Retry while the window is open, or send a template.

title: Replying to customers
text: Click New chat at the top of the conversation list. Enter the number with its country code, for example +14155552671, and click Start . If a chat with that number already exists, it opens. If not, an empty chat is created and the template picker opens, because you can only start a conversation with a template. Creating the chat sends nothing. When an agent starts a chat, it is assigned to them. When the owner starts one, it stays unassigned.

title: Replying to customers
text: Click the customer's name in the chat header to open Contact details . - Shopify orders : the customer's latest 5 orders , found by matching the WhatsApp number to the phone number on the Shopify customer. Each order shows its number, total, status (for example "Paid · Fulfilled" or "Cancelled"), date, and tracking links. The panel shows nothing more about the customer from Shopify. - If the chat came from an ad: the ad's headline and text, and Open ad . - Labels and Custom attributes for this chat. See Assign, label and note. - The customer's name and number, with Copy , Call and Chat . - Media, links and docs : every photo, file and link in the chat from the last 30 days. Use Select to download several files at once. - Whether the 24-hour window is open. The latest order also shows as a small chip above the chat, for example " 1042 · Paid · Fulfilled". If no orders show, check that the customer's phone number in Shopify is the same as their WhatsApp number.

title: Replying to customers
text: Message What to do "Claim this chat before replying." Click Claim chat , or ask the owner to assign the chat to you. "This chat belongs to another agent." Ask the owner to reassign it. "24h customer window is closed. Send a template instead." Send an approved template. You can send free-form messages again after the customer replies. "Shorten the message to 4,096 characters or fewer." Split the text into two messages. "Unsupported WhatsApp media type" Convert the file to a supported format from the table above. "This browser cannot record a WhatsApp-supported audio format." Upload an OGG, M4A or MP3 file instead, or use another browser. "No approved templates found for this account." Create a template and wait for Meta to approve it, then click Sync on the Templates page. "This template is not approved on the connected WhatsApp account." Pick a template and language that show as approved. "WhatsApp could not access the header media." Upload a new image, or use a direct public HTTPS link. "The number may not use WhatsApp, or has not accepted the latest WhatsApp terms." Check the number, or contact the customer another way. "Too many messages went to this number in a short time." Wai

title: Assign, label and note
text: Live Inbox has tools to keep a busy inbox under control: assign chats to teammates, mark them done, tag them with labels, leave private notes, set follow-up reminders and save the filters you use most.

title: Assign, label and note
text: New chats from customers are unassigned . Nothing is assigned automatically. Each chat is assigned to one person at a time. Who How Owner Use the Assignee dropdown above the chat to pick a teammate or Unassigned . The dropdown only shows when your store has more than one active team member. Agent Click Claim chat on an unassigned chat to take it, or Claim and reply in the reply box. Click Release chat to hand back a chat that is yours. - Agents can only reply to chats assigned to them. Only the owner can reassign a chat from one person to another. - When an agent starts a new chat, it is assigned to them. - If two agents claim the same chat at the same time, the second sees "This chat was already claimed." - When the owner disables an agent, all of that agent's chats become unassigned. Use the Mine and Unassigned queues at the top of the conversation list to see your chats and chats nobody has taken. When a teammate is typing a reply in the same chat, you see their name and "is typing a reply…", so two people don't answer the same customer.

title: Assign, label and note
text: Click Mark done in the chat header, or press E. On a phone, swipe a chat to the left. You see "Chat marked done. It returns when the customer writes again." with an Undo button. - A done chat stays done until the customer writes again. Then it reopens by itself. - Done chats leave the Needs reply and Closing soon lists and don't trigger window-closing alerts. - Use the Done status filter to see them. Click Reopen (or press E) to reopen one. - The owner can mark any chat done. An agent can mark a chat done if it is theirs or unassigned.

title: Assign, label and note
text: Labels are coloured tags you put on chats, such as "VIP", "Refund" or "Wholesale". Labels are shared across your store. Create labels Only the store owner can create, edit or delete labels. Live Inbox › Labels 1 to 50 characters. Must be unique in your store (capital letters don't count as different). One of 7 colours: green, blue, purple, amber, rose, cyan or orange. Custom colours are not available. There are no default labels. Deleting a label that is in use removes it from every chat. The inbox tells you how many chats are affected first. This cannot be undone. Use labels Everyone on the team can add and remove labels. - Open the customer panel by clicking the customer's name in the chat header, then add or remove labels. A chat can have several labels. - To label many chats at once, use the Add label… bulk action. - Filter the list with Label . Choose Unlabeled to find chats with no label. Labels belong to the chat, not to the customer.

title: Assign, label and note
text: Private notes are messages for your team. They are never sent to the customer. To add one, switch the reply box from Reply to Private note , type your note and click Add note (or press Ctrl+Enter, ⌘+Enter on Mac). Enter adds a new line. To write a note about a particular message, hover over it and choose Add private note . - Notes show in the chat as amber cards with the author and time. - Notes are text only, up to 4,096 characters. You can't edit or delete a note, attach files or mention a teammate. - Notes work when the 24-hour window is closed and when Live Inbox chat is turned off. - Notes don't change the unread count or the last message preview. - Everyone on the team can read and add notes on any chat.

title: Assign, label and note
text: Custom attributes are your own fields, such as "Customer type" or "Preferred size", that you fill in for each customer or chat. Create attributes Only the store owner can create attributes. Live Inbox › Custom Attributes 1 to 60 characters. 1 to 50 characters. Lowercase letters, numbers and underscores, starting with a letter. Cannot be changed later. Optional, up to 256 characters. Contact saves one value for the customer's phone number. Conversation saves a value for this chat only. Cannot be changed later. Text (up to 2,000 characters), number, date, checkbox (Yes/No) or dropdown (one choice from 1 to 50 options of up to 80 characters each). Cannot be changed later. You can't remove a dropdown option that is in use. Deleting an attribute also deletes all its values. The inbox shows how many values will be deleted first. Fill in values Everyone on the team can fill in values. Open the customer panel and edit the fields under Custom attributes , then save. If you switch tabs in the panel with unsaved changes, the inbox warns you first. Custom attributes stay in Live Inbox. They are not sent to Shopify or Meta.

title: Assign, label and note
text: A follow-up is a reminder to come back to a chat later. In the chat header, click Follow up (the bell). Choose In 1 hour , In 3 hours , Tomorrow 9:00 , In 3 days or Next Monday . Or pick your own date and time and click Set . You can add a short note of up to 200 characters. - Each chat can have one follow-up. It must be in the future and no more than one year ahead. - The chat shows a follow-up badge in the list. It turns red when the follow-up is due. - When it is due, the person who set it (or the chat's assignee) gets a push notification if push notifications are on for their device. See Inbox settings and shortcuts. - Click Mark follow-up done to clear it. - Use the Follow-ups status filter to see all chats with a follow-up, sorted by due time.

title: Assign, label and note
text: Today in the sidebar shows what needs attention now: due follow-ups, customers waiting for a reply, reply windows about to close, and today's new chats. Switch between Everyone and Mine at the top. The summary shows counts for Overdue , Due today , Needs reply and New today . Section What it lists Overdue follow-ups Follow-ups whose time has passed Follow-ups due today Follow-ups due later today Needs reply Customers waiting for an answer 24h window closing Chats whose reply window is about to close New chats today Chats that started today From ads today Today's chats that came from a click-to-WhatsApp ad Coming up (7 days) Follow-ups in the next week Each section shows up to 50 chats. Click Done to clear a follow-up. The page uses your own time zone and updates every minute.

title: Assign, label and note
text: Click Select conversations (the checklist icon) at the top of the list, or tick a chat, to select several chats. Click Select and the count of loaded chats to select every chat that is loaded. Action What it does Mark done Marks the chats done. Mark read Clears the unread count. Assign to… Owner only. Assigns the chats to a teammate or Unassigned . Assign to me Agents only. Claims the chats. Add label… Adds a label to the chats. When it finishes, you see how many chats were updated, for example "Marked done: 12 chats updated." If some fail, they stay selected and the message shows the first error. Click Cancel to leave select mode.

title: Assign, label and note
text: When you change the filters at the top of the list, Save this view appears. Click it to save the current queue, status, label and search as a chip you can click later. - You can save up to 8 views . - The name is made from the filters, for example "Mine · Needs reply · VIP". - Click × on a chip to remove the view. - Saved views are stored in this browser only . They are not shared with your team and don't appear on your other devices. The list also remembers your filters and scroll position while the browser tab stays open.

title: Assign, label and note
text: Pin a chat to keep it at the top of the list. Click the pin button on the chat in the list ( Pin conversation ), and click it again to unpin. On a phone, you can also swipe a chat to the right to pin or unpin it. Use the Pinned status filter to see only pinned chats. Pins are stored in this browser only . Your teammates don't see your pins, and your pins don't appear on your other devices.

title: Team members and roles
text: Everyone on your team gets their own Live Inbox login. The store owner creates agent accounts, and each agent signs in with a username and password. There is no limit on the number of team members and no per-seat fee.

title: Team members and roles
text: Live Inbox has two roles: - Owner . The store owner account. Clicking Open Live Inbox in the WhatFlow app in Shopify admin always signs in as the owner. There is one owner per store. - Agent . A team member account created by the owner. Agents sign in on the inbox login page with their own username and password. Shopify staff accounts are not linked to Live Inbox. Opening the inbox from Shopify admin always signs in as the owner, whoever clicks it. Give each team member an agent account instead. What each role can do Task Owner Agent See all chats Yes Yes Reply, send media, templates and interactive messages, react Any chat Only chats assigned to them Claim an unassigned chat Uses the Assignee dropdown Yes Release a chat Any chat Their own chats Assign or reassign chats to anyone Yes No Mark done, reopen, set follow-ups Any chat Chats that are theirs or unassigned Read and add private notes Any chat Any chat Add and remove labels on chats Yes Yes Create, edit and delete labels, canned responses and custom attributes Yes No Fill in custom attribute values Yes Yes Send AI drafts Yes Only in chats they can reply to Create templates Yes No, view only Broadcasts Yes No Create, publish a

title: Team members and roles
text: Live Inbox › Settings › Account & team Sign in as the owner and open Settings . Go to the Account & team section. Enter a Display name , a Username and an Initial password . Click Create agent . You see "Agent created. Share their username and initial password securely." Share the username and initial password privately. Also tell them your store's myshopify domain, for example yourstore.myshopify.com. They need it to sign in. Username and password rules Field Rules Username 3 to 32 characters. Starts with a letter. Letters, numbers, dots, dashes and underscores only. Saved in lowercase. Must be unique in your store. Password 12 to 128 characters.

title: Team members and roles
text: Agents sign in on the WhatFlow Inbox login page at inbox.whatflow.tech/auth/login. The owner can find a link with the store already filled in under Settings › Account & team ( Open store login ). In Store domain , type your store's myshopify domain, for example yourstore.myshopify.com. You can also type just yourstore. Your custom domain (such as yourstore.com) does not work here. Enter your Username (or the email on your account) and Password , then click Sign in . The first time you sign in, the inbox opens Settings with Set your password . Enter the initial password from your store owner as your current password, then choose a new password of 12 to 128 characters. After you save, the inbox opens. You cannot see chats until you change the initial password. After you sign in, you stay signed in on that browser for 7 days. The owner must have opened Live Inbox from Shopify admin at least once before anyone can sign in on the login page. To sign out, open the account menu at the bottom of the sidebar and click Sign out .

title: Team members and roles
text: The Team members list under Account & team shows each person's name, username, whether they are Active or Disabled , and their last login. The owner has an Owner badge. The owner can do the following for each agent: Action What happens Change username Sets a new username. The agent signs in with the new one. Agents cannot change their own username. Reset password Sets a new password, signs the agent out everywhere, and makes them change it at their next sign-in. Disable Signs the agent out, stops them signing in, and unassigns all their chats. Enable Lets a disabled agent sign in again. You cannot delete a team member. Disable them instead. The owner account cannot be changed or disabled here.

title: Team members and roles
section: Set a password for the owner
text: The owner normally opens the inbox from Shopify admin and has no password. To sign in directly on the login page (for example on a phone), set a username and password. 1. Open the inbox from Shopify admin with Open Live Inbox . 2. Within 10 minutes, go to Settings › Account & team › Your login . 3. Enter a username and a password together, then save. Later changes need either your current password or a fresh launch from Shopify admin in the last 10 minutes. Changing your password signs out your other sessions.

title: Team members and roles
text: Problem Fix A teammate opens the inbox from Shopify and lands in the owner account Opening from Shopify always signs in as the owner. Create an agent account for them and have them use the login page. "Invalid store, username, or password." Check that the store domain is the myshopify domain, not your custom domain. Check the username and password. Make sure the owner has opened the inbox from Shopify at least once. "Too many attempts. Try again in 15 minutes." Too many wrong passwords. Wait 15 minutes and try again. An agent lands on Settings and can't see chats They must change their initial password first. "Password must be 12–128 characters." Choose a longer password. "Username already exists in this store." Pick a different username. "Enter your current password or reopen the Inbox from Shopify to confirm this change." Open the inbox again from Shopify admin and make the change within 10 minutes. An agent can't reply: "Claim this chat before replying." Click Claim chat , or ask the owner to assign it. An agent can't see Broadcasts or Workflows These are owner-only.

title: Inbox broadcasts
text: Inbox broadcasts send one approved WhatsApp template to many customers at once, from inside Live Inbox. You pick the audience from a spreadsheet, past chats or opted-in Shopify customers, send now or schedule, and then follow delivery, reads and button clicks. Only the store owner can use broadcasts. Agents don't see the Broadcasts page. WhatFlow also has broadcasts in the WhatFlow app in Shopify admin. They are a separate tool. This page covers broadcasts sent from Live Inbox. For broadcasts from Shopify admin, see Broadcasts. Both respect the same Blocklist.

title: Inbox broadcasts
text: - A broadcast always sends an approved template , so you can reach customers whose 24-hour window is closed. See WhatsApp rules to know. - Messages go out one by one at the speed you choose. - Numbers on your blocklist and duplicate numbers are left out. - Each delivered message is charged by Meta by template category, and counts toward your WhatFlow plan. - Replies from customers arrive in Live Inbox like any other message.

title: Inbox broadcasts
text: Live Inbox › Broadcasts The page shows Total broadcasts , Messages sent , Avg delivery rate and Avg read rate . Use the tabs All broadcasts , Active / Sending , Drafts and Completed to filter the list. The Opt-out blocklist button opens your blocklist.

title: Inbox broadcasts
text: Click New broadcast . The wizard has four steps. Give the broadcast a name and choose the WhatsApp number to send from. Set Sending speed & API throttling . The slider sets the pause between messages, from 100 ms (10 messages a second, "Fast") to 1,000 ms (1 message a second, "Conservative"). The default is 200 ms, 5 messages a second ("Recommended"). Select an approved template. A preview shows how it looks. If you pick a product template, choose the products too. Product templates need a synced catalog. Choose who gets the broadcast. title: Auto-replies
text: Auto-replies answer a customer's WhatsApp message straight away when it matches words you choose. Use them for questions customers ask again and again, such as "where is my order?", returns or payment options. Home › Auto Replier

title: Auto-replies
text: Each auto-reply is a rule with two parts: the text to look for, and the reply to send. When a customer sends you a message, WhatFlow checks it against every rule that is on. If a rule matches, WhatFlow sends that rule's reply right away. - Only one auto-reply is sent per customer message. If several rules match, only the rule with the lowest Order number replies. - The reply is sent as a WhatsApp reply that quotes the customer's message. Emoji reactions are the only exception. - Auto-replies are free-form replies to a customer who has just written to you, so they are always inside the 24-hour window. They do not need an approved template. - Auto-replies are never stopped by the Blocklist. - Each auto-reply that Meta accepts counts as one message toward your plan. See Plans and billing. WhatFlow auto-replies are keyword rules only. There is no welcome message, no away message and no business-hours setting. The Opening hours starter is an ordinary keyword rule with fixed text: it replies with the same text at any time of day, and you edit the hours in the text yourself.

text: These actions send one of your approved WhatsApp templates through WhatFlow, from your connected business number. title: Broadcasts
text: A broadcast sends one approved WhatsApp template to many customers at once, such as a sale announcement or a new collection. You start a broadcast from the customer list or a customer segment in Shopify admin, and WhatFlow sends the messages one by one in the background.

title: Broadcasts
text: - You choose the audience in Shopify admin: between 1 and 250 selected customers, or a whole customer segment. - You choose an approved template and a delay between messages. - WhatFlow prepares the list of recipients, then sends one message at a time, spaced by the delay you chose. - You follow progress, cancel or retry on the Broadcast Queue page in WhatFlow. Sending starts as soon as the recipient list is ready. You can't schedule a broadcast for a later date or time. Home › Guides › Customer Broadcast The in-app guide repeats these steps. The number behind the button can be any WhatsApp number. It doesn't have to be the number you connected to WhatFlow. title: Shopify Flow
text: Shopify Flow lets you build your own automations. WhatFlow adds WhatsApp actions (send a template, text, media or buttons) and WhatsApp triggers (a customer sent a message, tapped a button or opted out) to Flow. Use it for messages WhatFlow's built-in automations don't cover, or to react to what customers send you. Home › Guides › Flow Integration The in-app guide is called Shopify Flow Integration . Using WhatFlow in Flow is free; messages you send still count toward your plan.

title: Shopify Flow
text: - WhatsApp is connected in WhatFlow. See Connect WhatsApp. - You have an active WhatFlow subscription. - You have at least one approved template, if you want to send templates. See Message templates. - Shopify Flow is installed in your store. It is free from the Shopify App Store.

title: Shopify Flow
section: Send a template from a workflow
text: In Shopify admin, go to Apps and open Flow . Click Create workflow . Click Select a trigger and choose the store event that should start the workflow, for example Order created , Order fulfilled , Order paid or Order cancelled . Add conditions after the trigger if you only want some orders, for example orders above a certain value. Click + below the trigger or condition, search for WhatFlow , and select Send WhatsApp Template . WhatFlow actions are listed under Apps in the action picker. Enter the Template Name , the Recipient Phone Number and any variables. Use Add variable to fill fields from the order, for example the customer's phone or first name. The bottom of the action panel shows a preview when WhatFlow finds the template. Click Test workflow , choose a recent order and click Run test . Open the Test results tab in the WhatFlow action panel to see if the message was sent. Click Apply changes to save, then turn the workflow on. Testing sends a real WhatsApp message to the phone number on the order you choose. Use a test order with your own phone number so you don't message real customers while you set things up.

title: Data, privacy and uninstalling
text: This page explains what happens to your WhatsApp connection and your data when you uninstall WhatFlow, and how WhatFlow handles Shopify's customer and shop data deletion requests.

title: Data, privacy and uninstalling
text: To send and track your messages, WhatFlow stores things such as: - Your WhatsApp connection to Meta. - Your templates, automation settings and auto-reply rules. - Live Inbox contacts and conversations. - Records of the messages it sent and which order or customer they were about, so customer replies can be linked to the right order. - Your blocklist, opt-out settings and Store Report settings. - Your AI connections and their activity log, if you connected an AI app. See AI apps (MCP). Some short-lived data is cleared automatically. For example, media download links in Shopify Flow triggers expire after 7 days.

title: Data, privacy and uninstalling
text: When What happens Right away WhatFlow's access to your Shopify store is removed. All AI connections and API keys are revoked. Automations stop, and WhatFlow ignores incoming WhatsApp messages for your store. For 1 hour Your WhatsApp connection is kept. If you reinstall WhatFlow within the hour, it is still connected and you don't need to set it up again. After 1 hour If you have not reinstalled, WhatFlow disconnects your WhatsApp number: it stops receiving your number's messages from Meta, deletes its saved WhatsApp access, and turns off your Live Inbox channel. About 48 hours later Shopify asks WhatFlow to delete your shop's data (see below). Uninstalling WhatFlow does not delete your WhatsApp Business account, phone number or templates at Meta. They stay in your Meta Business account, and you can connect the number to WhatFlow again later. See Connect WhatsApp. If you reinstall after the hour has passed, connect WhatsApp again.

title: Data, privacy and uninstalling
text: About 48 hours after you uninstall, Shopify sends WhatFlow a request to delete your shop's data. WhatFlow then deletes: - Live Inbox contacts. - All AI connections, API keys, AI drafts and the AI activity log. - Emails WhatFlow had scheduled for your store. - Your Shopify Flow trigger subscriptions. - Your blocklist entries and opt-out settings. - Your Store Report settings. If you want other data removed, contact support@whatflow.tech.

title: Data, privacy and uninstalling
text: Shopify sends WhatFlow your customers' privacy requests. - Customer data deletion (redaction). When a customer asks Shopify to delete their data, WhatFlow deletes that customer's Live Inbox contacts, found by customer and by phone number, and the records that link WhatsApp messages to that customer, their phone number and their orders. - Customer data request. WhatFlow records the request. To get a copy of a customer's WhatsApp data, contact support@whatflow.tech.

title: Data, privacy and uninstalling
text: - Customer consent to receive WhatsApp messages is your responsibility. WhatFlow's Blocklist helps you honour opt-outs.
